snippet.title: Dark Coffee - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Dark Coffee, a cozy horror visual novel developed by TwoArtist. Players will manage a quaint coffee shop to serve visitors, make key decisions, and brew delicious drinks in the process. Dark Coffee is coming soon to PC (Steam).
